To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
financial actors were able the set the agenda for the financial discussion in Finland, and they did so.
the financial news is mostly based on the sources that are connected to the financial sector, and that the sources of news are mostly men.
the financial news had approximately two sources per news, and that the financial news was mainly based on men, financial actors and the media.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question: who sets the agenda for public discussion on economic issues?
a very important question: who has the power to set the agenda in the Finnish public financial discussion?
the source practices of journalists, and the agenda setting of financial news.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the financial news in the Finnish newspapers was mostly set by the financial actors and the political actors were used more frequently as a source than the citizens.
the agenda for the public financial discussion was set mostly by men, financial actors and other media.
the agenda of public financial discussion is set by the financial actors and the media, and the agenda is set by men, not by women.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
men, companies, financial societies, authorities, political actors and other media set the agenda for discussion in the big audience financial news in Finland.
the financial actors were able set the agenda for the public discussion of the financial issues more frequently than the authorities and the political actors.
the public financial discussion was dominated by men, companies and financial actors.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is very important to increase women’s presence and participation in the media as sources, and that citizens’ and citizens advocacy groups’ voices must also be heard in financial discussion.
the financial news was dominated by the sources from the financial industry and financial actors.
the public’s discussion about financial matters is mostly controlled by financial actors themselves, and the public is rarely able to set the financial agenda.
